headline: SpaceX caught a Starship upper stage; Nvidia and Anthropic jolted the AI trade
bottomLine: SpaceX caught Starship's upper stage for the first time, while Nvidia's board refused Jensen Huang's return and Anthropic's record IPO gave back most of its first-day gain. Fed officials floated more hikes and Bitcoin fell below $63,000.

portfolio.title: SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage for the first time
portfolio.brief: SpaceX caught Starship's upper stage on Nov 14, a first, reported by CNBC, NPR, BBC and the NYT. Wells Fargo says it could speed the path to full reusability.
portfolio.impact: Reusing the ship, not just the booster, is what drives Starship's cost per launch down. It widens SpaceX's lead the same week ULA lost 40 Amazon satellites, though SPCX still slid after the Anthropic IPO.
portfolio.action: Ask SpaceX investor relations for the lock-up expiry schedule, then decide at the next partner call whether post-catch strength is the window for the fund's next sale tranche.

portfolio.brief: Perplexity says it reached $1B in annualized revenue at about one-fifth of Anthropic's cost, and its CEO said an IPO could come as soon as 2027. It also launched an Orchestrator API covering 45+ models.

portfolio.title: Judge appears divided as Amazon seeks to block Perplexity's shopping agents
portfolio.brief: At a hearing, a federal judge appeared divided on Amazon's bid to block Perplexity's AI agents, Bloomberg Law reported on Nov 20. No ruling has been reported.
portfolio.impact: An injunction would hit the agent products at the center of Perplexity's growth story and set precedent for every agentic browser. This is a bigger near-term risk to its IPO case than any revenue figure.
portfolio.action: Ask Perplexity's general counsel for the ruling timeline and the product fallback if Amazon wins, before the next partner call.

thesis.title: US chip curbs and Nvidia's China exit show state action overriding markets
thesis.brief: Commerce curbed China's remote access to advanced chips; TSMC and Samsung reportedly paused some China shipments. Nvidia says it is done selling there, and the SEC is reportedly probing it.
thesis.impact: State action reshaped the top AI chipmaker's biggest export market within days, amid an espionage-linked scandal. That is the sudden-executive-action pattern we called, and it favors assets no state can seize.

thesis.title: Fed hawks and a weaker Bitcoin cut against the loose-money call
thesis.brief: Musalem says four more hikes may be needed and Waller wants a 50bp December hike; Bitcoin fell below $63,000. Yet Wells Fargo doubled its BlackRock bitcoin ETF stake to $2.35B in Q3.
thesis.impact: A hiking Fed contradicts the 'money too loose' premise for now, and Bitcoin is not behaving as a refuge. Institutional ETF buying is the one piece that still fits our call.
